_about: VSI project catalog. kind: 'esa' = ESA SpOC challenge (data + official scorer from ESA), 'custom' = written brief from the professor. verified: the source page was read and PROBLEM.md reflects it. Agents: find the student's project here by title/aliases, then run `vsi new <slug> <dir>`.

projects.title: Torso Decompositions
projects.summary: Bi-objective graph problem: choose a vertex ordering + threshold t to maximise torso size and minimise torso width (fill-in out-degree). Submit up to 20 vectors, scored by hypervolume.

projects.title: Interferometric Mission
projects.summary: Choose relative initial position/velocity of N satellites around a mothership so their projections form as many distinct baselines as possible at 3 times (Golomb-like). Single-objective, continuous.

projects.title: Programmable Cubes
projects.summary: Reconfigure an ensemble of cubes into a target spacecraft (ISS, JWST, Enterprise) with a short sequence of legal pivot moves. Combinatorial planning.

projects.title: Luna Tomato Logistics
projects.summary: Maximum-weight 3-dimensional matching of Earth orbit -> Moon orbit -> destination transfers (NP-hard), plus an advanced trajectory-design version.

projects.title: Luna Tomato Advertising
projects.summary: Select orbits and phases for spacecraft whose lunar occultations reproduce a Morse-code signal (MSE <= 0.05) with as few spacecraft as possible.

projects.title: Keplerian Tomato Traveling Salesperson
projects.summary: Time-dependent TSP around the Moon: visit all tomato orbits with Lambert transfers under a delta-v limit, minimising total mission time.

projects.title: Morphing Rovers
projects.summary: Design 4 rover terrain masks + a neural-network controller (19 133 parameters) so rovers reach 30 samples on 6 Mars maps as fast as possible.

projects.title: Quantum Communications Constellations
projects.summary: Bi-objective: design two Walker constellations + choose 4 rover sites to minimise quantum-link cost and constellation cost; scored by hypervolume.

projects.title: Trappist Tour
projects.summary: Bi-objective trajectory: visit all 7 TRAPPIST-1 planets once, minimising total delta-v and mission time; scored by hypervolume.

projects.title: Delivery Scheduling
projects.summary: Purely combinatorial: assign 340 asteroids to 12 stations with non-overlapping activity windows to maximise the minimum delivered mass.

projects.title: Mining
projects.summary: Route a ship through a 10 000-asteroid belt for 1 827 days with limited propellant, maximising the scarcest of three prepared materials.

projects.title: The Trigger Arc TSP
projects.summary: TSP variant where traversing some arcs (triggers) changes the cost of other arcs. The assignment gave no link: ask the professor for the official problem statement and instances.

projects.title: DNA Genome Reconstruction from Noisy Sequencing Reads
projects.summary: Reconstruct a DNA sequence from short noisy reads: k-mer indexing, approximate overlaps, overlap graph, assembly, error correction, variant detection, scalability.

projects.title: AI-Based Protein Structure Prediction and Optimization
projects.summary: Fold an amino-acid sequence on a 2D/3D lattice minimising an energy function; at least two search algorithms (GA, SA, beam, B&B…), search-space reduction, local improvement, experiments.

projects.title: Chronos Nexus: Autonomous Interstellar Civilization Optimization
projects.summary: Dynamic galaxy graph: multi-objective routing, resource allocation (flow), mission scheduling, infrastructure (knapsack), dynamic re-planning, prediction, uncertainty; ≥3 techniques; report as GitHub README.

projects.title: AI-Powered Multi-Robot Coordination in Dynamic Environments
projects.summary: Robots on a dynamic grid: multi-agent RL (MADQL/PPO), online path planning (A*/RRT*), auction-based task allocation, priority handling, simulation with moving obstacles.

projects.title: Time Travel Paradox Detection and Timeline Optimization
projects.summary: Events as a directed graph with time-travel back edges: detect causal cycles (DFS/SCC/topological sort), identify paradoxes, find a minimum-cost repair, compare approaches.

projects.title: Traffic Flow Optimization in a City Grid Using Dijkstra and A*
projects.summary: Weighted city grid with traffic delays: Dijkstra and A* fastest routes, dynamic edge-weight updates from congestion data.
